You won't be at school. ☂️ You can't follow them in, and you may never know what happens there. But your words can go with them.

Nora is six. Every morning her mom hands her a yellow umbrella, and reminds her what to remember:
1️⃣ You don't have to follow the crowd.
2️⃣ Never hurt someone to fit in.
3️⃣ A real friend won't make you feel small.
4️⃣ Your body belongs to you.
5️⃣ Walk away when you can. That makes you strong. 💪
6️⃣ One bad day doesn't define you. It's not who you are.
7️⃣ If something feels wrong, tell someone. That's brave.
8️⃣ You can always tell me the truth, no matter what happens. ❤️

When she feels alone, God is still there. "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble." Psalm 46:1 (ESV) 🙏 He's in every classroom. And Jesus, who died for our sins and rose again, is with her in the rain.

Four years later, the other kids are laughing at a boy standing alone in the rain. Nora walks over and stands right by his side. ☂️❤️

Your words go where you can't. ❤️ And if your child is carrying worry into those school doors, you don't have to wait to help.
